working_tree: Clean at start; current correction and evidence are uncommitted. Executed runtime, test and dependency SHA-256 values are recorded below.
objective: Deliver a connected form submission behind a busy polling write while preserving no reconnect replay during stale connection state.

environment.browser: Headless system Chromium with --no-sandbox in this container

provenance.source_note: No legacy files extracted in this session. Historical archive, source inventory, and the earlier 0.1.0 execution record are preserved unchanged.

baseline.command: CHAT_TEST_CLIENT_PATH=/tmp/creative-ai-p11-0.1.0-client.js node --test --test-name-pattern='in-flight polling write|stale connected state' tests/browser.test.cjs
baseline.method: Playwright route serves only the recorded client; unchanged server and other assets use the working project. Repository files are not replaced.

outcomes.test: a connected form submission waits behind an in-flight polling write
outcomes.outcome: Expected two rendered messages never arrived in the sender list; timeout after 4000 ms.
outcomes.cause: Volatile emission discards the form message while the live transport is temporarily unwritable.

outcomes.test: a stale connected state does not retain a message for reconnect replay
outcomes.boundary: Force the pinned client heartbeat predicate to report expiry while connected remains true and WebSocket transport is writable; restore predicate immediately.
outcomes.cause: The old volatile flag does not prevent Socket.IO queuing when its connection check rejects an otherwise writable transport.

correction.behavior: Use normal acknowledged emission for the live Engine.IO write queue, then immediately clear Socket.IO reconnect sendBuffer. Existing offline guard, timeout, draft handling, inclusive broadcast and rendering rules remain.
correction.dependencies: No resolved package changes; only working-project version metadata changed in package and lockfile.

targeted_verification.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='in-flight polling write|stale connected state' tests/browser.test.cjs

tests.name: protocol broadcasts trimmed messages to sender and peer in order
non-string payloads are rejected without broadcasts
empty and whitespace-only payloads are rejected without broadcasts
501 code units are rejected even when trimming would shorten the payload
500 UTF-16 code units are accepted including non-ASCII text
messages without acknowledgement callbacks do not crash the server
two browser clients display accepted messages once in both directions
a connected form submission waits behind an in-flight polling write
a stale connected state does not retain a message for reconnect replay
markup remains literal text in both browsers
rejection is visible, preserves the draft, and does not broadcast
a departed client keeps its draft and receives only future messages on rejoining
transport interruption reconnects automatically without duplicating listeners
browser retains only the latest 200 messages
new browser receives future messages without server-side history
missing acknowledgement reports uncertainty and does not retry automatically
an acknowledgement does not erase a newer draft typed during sending
